description.fun: Klefki is a living key ring with a magpie habit: it sneaks into homes to steal keys, especially master keys, and rattles its collection to scare off predators. It once lived in mines, but when the metal it fed on ran short it moved in with people, and now it nibbles metal ions from keyholes. It never lets go of a key it likes, so nobles once trusted it with their vault keys.
description.guide: Klefki is a Steel- and Fairy-type Pokémon from Kalos shaped like a key ring. It collects keys, feeding on their metal ions and jangling them to deter predators, and will hold onto a favourite key for decades. In the past, noble families entrusted Klefki with important keys.
description.tagline: A key ring that steals your keys and never gives them back
